blocker.summary: The r399 allocator double-issue is RESOLVED (r413/r414/r415). The r418-r421 shutdown hang is FIXED and LIVE-VERIFIED (r422), with automated regression coverage added (r424). Separate, not-yet-fixed discovery from r424: HEAD has never been buildable from a byte-for-byte fresh clone (native_vulkan_backend.cpp has never had Vulkan linkage in any committed CMakeLists.txt) -- named for a dedicated future cycle. r427 found the ROOT CAUSE of presented_frames=0/present=0: our host stub for VdSwap (tools/materialize_native_import_stubs.py) only reads ctx.r3 for ring-cursor bookkeeping and discards ctx.r4 through ctx.r10 entirely -- it never constructs or injects the XE_SWAP PM4 packet a real Xbox 360 kernel's VdSwap implementation would build from those arguments; the game itself never writes that packet (by design, matching real hardware). r428 captured all 7 arguments live across the 5 VdSwap calls in a 25s window and partially decoded them: r6=0x16520008 is fixed on every call and lands in the already-known 'readback'/event-notification guest memory region (0x1652xxxx); r5 points to an 8-word block that is byte-identical across every single call (0x8a000002 0x135c0006 0x0059e4ff 0x00001414 0x00000000 0x00000200 0x00000000 0x00000004) -- consistent with a static, session-long display format/mode descriptor rather than a per-frame payload; r4 points to an 8-word block that varies per call, whose word at offset +20 takes plausible GPU/texture memory addresses (0x2e33449c, 0x8288db80 across different calls) and is the leading candidate for the front-buffer pointer, though not yet confirmed by independent cross-check. r7/r8/r9/r10 were captured but not analyzed. Also ruled out along the way: the 4-word ring write immediately preceding the VdSwap call in sub_821F03B0 decodes (via its lis/ori constant construction) to an ordinary EventWriteShd packet (opcode 0x58, with 0xDEADBEEF as a hardcoded payload constant, not uninitialized-stack garbage) -- not the missing XE_SWAP packet. Named for r429: confirm whether r4's +20 word truly points to a live render-surface-shaped memory region, decode r7-r10, then design/apply/live-verify a fix that has the VdSwap stub construct and inject a real XE_SWAP packet. The standing uncommitted-tree situation (r239+, over the 2026-09-02 mass deletion) remains the user's decision, untouched beyond what r422 already swept in -- reports and named tool/source changes for r413-r428 were committed individually.
